list: Official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; all offline single-player

guide_sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

roadmap_note: Roadmap built from the official descriptions and the three-step routes published by PowerPyx and KeenGamer: story first (60-80 hours), then the 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours), then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (10-20 hours). About 200 hours in total, one playthrough, no online play, no mission replay — keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy you will earn, after the story, the 100% checklist and every side activity, so treat the roadmap on this page as its real guide: story first, then the checklist, then cleanup.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1 of the roadmap) to unlock free roam and the 100% checklist.
Complete the 100% Completion checklist (Stage 2) — this is where most of the remaining trophies live.
Mop up Strangers & Freaks strands and any open combat, driving and money trophies (Stage 3).
The platinum unlocks the moment the 54th trophy pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. You play it as Jason, and it also introduces fishing — the activity behind the Baited My Tackle trophy later. Just follow the mission markers through the start of the game.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening as Jason.
Follow the Gone Fishing mission markers to the end; the trophy pops on completion.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 1 is also where the game's only missable moment lives: before the chapter closes, do the one-time balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it cannot be done again afterwards.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's main missions.
Before the final Chapter 1 mission, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (after the mission Down to Earth, find her in the kitchen in the morning).
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops at the close.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions; it unlocks when the chapter ends. From here on Jason and Lucia are playable together, which the later meditation spots need — several of the 18 spots only open up once both characters are available.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's main missions in order.
Use the chapter to start scanning vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3's main missions and it pops at the chapter close. Keep taking optional missions as their icons appear on the map — they feed the 100% checklist later, which wants 100 optional tasks done, so skipping them now only adds grind after the story.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's main missions.
Take optional missions (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters) whenever they appear.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4's main missions. This is the chapter where the big bank vault robberies open up through the mission That's Where The Money Is… — do not skip the robbery introductions, because the 100% checklist later wants all 8 bank vaults robbed and all 22 bank jobs done.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's main missions.
Complete the vault robbery introduction (That's Where The Money Is…) when it appears.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final story mission and the credits roll with this trophy. After the story you return to free roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats — that checklist is the rest of the road to the platinum, about 100 more hours.
steps: Finish the final story mission.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist for Stage 2 of the roadmap.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the main mission Breakfast Run as the story brings it up — just follow the mission markers when it appears. Like every named story-mission trophy, it pops on completion and needs no preparation.
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission marker appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a set story beat, so follow the mission markers when it unlocks and play it through — the heist also teaches the robbery flow that the bank vault and bank job trophies use later.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission marker appears.
Complete the heist; the trophy pops on completion.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the main mission Child's Play when the story brings it up. There is nothing to prepare and no way to fail it permanently — if a mission attempt fails, replay it from the checkpoint until it is done.
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission marker appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the main mission Headliners. Like every named story-mission trophy, it pops on completion and cannot be missed — the story always brings the mission to you.
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission marker appears.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a set story beat — follow the mission markers when it unlocks — and it also introduces the airport, where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned later.
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission marker appears.
Complete the mission at the airport; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory when the story brings it up. Expect a heavy combat mission — stock up on armour and ammo beforehand, but the trophy itself only needs the mission finished.
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission marker appears.
Stock up, then complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind — gold, and most of the roughly 200-hour platinum. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. You do not need literally everything: most rows ask for a portion (for example 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts), but a few rows demand the full set — every gang operation (39), bank job (22), payday loan job (7), bank vault (8), underwater discovery (33), shooting-range gold (42), drone time trial (42) and Bret target deck (15). Progress made during the story already counts, so the scanning and studying you did early is not wasted.
steps: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and read every row — the full table is in Stage 2 of the roadmap on this page.

Clear the 'all of them' rows first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 15 Bret target decks.

Then work the partial rows to their targets: 100 optional tasks, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 30 of 40 races won.
Skip the ten hardest Challenges — only 70 of 80 are needed.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Stunts you do naturally while driving count, and the 100% checklist wants 300 of them, so keep going past 250. Track your total in the Progress menu and use the map's stunt markers to find ones you have not tried.
steps: Turn on stunt markers on the map and work through them as you travel — any jump, under-bridge flight, knife flight or base jump counts.
Check your stunt total in the Progress menu; the trophy pops at 250.
Keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist needs that many.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, bowling, basketball, mini-golf and the arcade games. One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. Tick them off early in free roam so you know which are left, and use this trophy as a tour of the activities the other trophies ask more of.
steps: Visit each activity once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, bowling, basketball, mini-golf, arcade.
One attempt is enough per type — no win required.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every shooting range in Leonida and play each challenge until gold — the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional for the platinum. Use a steady weapon you are comfortable with and replay a challenge as many times as it takes; gold thresholds are shown in the range before you start.
steps: Find every shooting range in Leonida — each holds several challenges.
Play each challenge until you hit its gold score; replaying is free and unlimited.
Use a weapon you control well rather than the most powerful one; accuracy beats firepower here.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; winning once per location is enough for the trophy, while the 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials finished. Learn the racing line on a slow first pass, then go for the win — the time trials teach you the course before you race it.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Fly a slow practice pass to learn the gates, then race for the win.
Win once per location; the trophy pops after the 14th win.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race twice does not count twice. Leonida has 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, so aim past 20 while you are at it. Pick a fast car you trust, use the race markers on the map, and start with the shorter circuits to learn the handling.
steps: Open the map and work through race markers — each race only counts the first time you win it.
Win 20 different races for the trophy; push on to 30 for the 100% checklist.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced through the story's Gone Fishing mission; afterwards you can take on fishing challenges, and Cal is the rival to beat. Pick a good spot, watch the line tension and reel steadily — do not yank when the line goes taut or it snaps.
steps: Finish the story mission Gone Fishing to unlock fishing.
Take on fishing challenges until Cal appears as your rival.
Beat Cal by managing line tension: reel steadily, ease off when the line strains.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any machine counts and one completed game is enough. The 100% checklist asks you to play all four video games, so try the rest while you are there — and one arcade visit also ticks an activity type for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade in Leonida and pick any machine.
Play it through to completion — the trophy pops when the game ends.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.when: Side strand — after story opens it
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger and side strands appear as their icons on the map as the story opens them up — follow Andy's chain to its end. His finale is one of the five character finales that count toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
steps: Watch the map for Andy's strand icon as the story progresses.
Play each of Andy's missions in order until the final one.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.when: Side strand — after story opens it
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Kenton also ties into the treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 treasure sets found — so collect treasure maps as you go and his strand will pay twice.
steps: Watch the map for Kenton's strand icon as the story progresses.
Play each of Kenton's missions in order until the final one.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.when: Side strand — after story opens it
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so check the map for Billy's icon between chapters and after story beats — a strand only opens when the story reaches it.
steps: Watch the map for Billy's strand icon as the story progresses.
Play each of Billy's missions in order until the final one.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete eight full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the game, so you can skip one you dislike — but a strand only counts when its final mission is done, not when it starts. The five character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are strands of their own and count toward the eight.
steps: Play the five character finales first — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — five of the eight.
Pick any three more stranger strands from the map icons and finish each to its final mission.
The trophy pops when the eighth strand's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.when: Side strand — after story opens it
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Randy's chain from its first map icon to its finale; like the other character finales it also counts as one of the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
steps: Watch the map for Randy's strand icon as the story progresses.
Play each of Randy's missions in order until the final one.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.when: Side strand — after story opens it
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Tyrone's chain from its first map icon to its finale; like the other character finales it also counts as one of the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
steps: Watch the map for Tyrone's strand icon as the story progresses.
Play each of Tyrone's missions in order until the final one.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops at the end.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 — DO FIRST, before Ch. 1 ends
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this first. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The catch is in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and accept. That balcony meditation raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it cannot be done again after Chapter 1 — it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The other spots open up as you explore; the last ones need Jason and Lucia playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2. Note: the 100% checklist only wants 15 of 18 meditations, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
steps: CHAPTER 1, right after the mission Down to Earth: in the morning, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony when she says she is going to meditate, and accept. Do this before Chapter 1 ends — it cannot be repeated.
After Chapter 2 (both characters playable), visit meditation spots as you explore Leonida and meditate at each one.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter as a safety net — there is no mission replay.
The trophy pops at the 18th meditation.
trophies.note: It is still unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation counts toward the 18 — PowerPyx and KeenGamer both flag it as the one missable moment and advise doing it to be safe.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strands (his Target Decks) ask you to track down specific animals; finish one of his unique-animal hunts. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of Bret's target decks done, so you will be hunting for him anyway. Study animals through binoculars first — studying 100 species is a separate checklist row, and a studied animal is easier to track.
steps: Find Bret's hunting strand and take a Target Deck contract.
Track the named animal — study it through binoculars first if you can.
Complete the hunt; the trophy pops on your first unique-animal kill for Bret.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete three full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so you will be collecting cards for a long while — three sets is just the early milestone. Cards are scattered across Leonida; use the map and your collection screen to see which sets are nearly done, and finish the smallest sets first.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore — check your collection screen for sets that are nearly complete.
Finish the three smallest sets first for the early trophy.
Keep collecting: the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Open the WAiNK app on your in-game phone and scan 100 different locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scan everything unfamiliar as you travel, because the 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans and vehicles can be scanned too (200 base-model vehicles). Start the habit in Chapter 1 and it is mostly done by the time the story ends.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your in-game phone whenever you pass something unfamiliar.
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — each new location counts once.
The trophy pops at 100 scanned locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are small objectives spread across combat, driving, exploration and activities — check the Challenges list in the Progress menu and pick off the easy ones first. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so you can skip the ten hardest; this trophy is the halfway mark on the way there.
steps: Open the Challenges list in the Progress menu.
Clear the easy ones first — driving, exploration and activity challenges are usually quickest.
The trophy pops at 50; push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with good cover and a fast car waiting — break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, then drive clear. Easiest once both characters are playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2.
steps: Bring your partner along (available after Chapter 2).
Build a 4-star wanted level — cause chaos in a quiet area, not in the middle of a mission.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars blink, then drive clear in a fast car.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the heat on the whole time. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without hiding or getting busted. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and scout three shops close together on the map.
Rob the first shop, then drive straight to the next — do not hide or lose the cops.
Rob all three without the wanted level ever clearing; the trophy pops after the third.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a quick WAiNK scan of a new vehicle is enough to count it. Scan every unfamiliar car, bike and boat you pass from the start of the game; the 100% checklist separately wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this habit pays twice.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan every unfamiliar vehicle you pass — cars, bikes and boats all count.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles; keep scanning to 200 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it runs out. A gang shootout or a police chase with several officers nearby is the natural place for it — do not waste it on a single straggler.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together — a gang shootout or a police chase.
Trigger Combat Focus only when several targets are in range.
Drop five enemies before it runs out; the trophy pops immediately.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.when: Any time — Vice City International Airport
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off in it — an unscheduled departure, in the trophy's words. Head to the runways, board a plane that is about to leave and get airborne before security stops you. Expect a wanted level the moment you cross the tarmac, so be quick.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport and reach the runways.
Board a passenger aircraft that is about to depart.
Take off — the trophy pops once you are airborne.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.when: Any time — high wanted level / military sites
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks show up when your wanted level is high and the military responds — or at military sites. Grab one, then put its cannon to work. The tank is slow and a big target, so use it in open ground, not in narrow streets.
steps: Raise your wanted level until the military responds, or visit a military site.
Steal a Rhino tank and get inside.
Use its cannon in combat; the trophy pops once you fight in it.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt costs nothing but the trip.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout its cameras and staff sightlines first.
Move quietly, stay out of sight, take the goods.
Leave before anyone raises the alarm — the trophy pops on a clean getaway.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. The big vault jobs open up during Chapter 4 through the mission That's Where The Money Is… — the 100% checklist wants all eight vaults robbed, so keep going to eight. Plan your getaway car before you go in, and do not linger after the vault is open.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and complete That's Where The Money Is… to unlock vault jobs.
Rob a vault, then escape — repeat five times for the trophy.
Keep going to all eight vaults; the 100% checklist needs them.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops. A quiet approach on a lonely road works better than a shootout in traffic: block the road, stop the truck, then grab the cash and go.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route around Leonida.
Stop it — block the road rather than opening fire in traffic.
Crack it open, take the cash, and lose the cops to escape.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.when: Any time — best after the story
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the map. Drive, fly and sail through every named area until the map is fully uncovered. The easiest way is a long road trip after the story, checking the map for dark patches you have never visited. A plane or helicopter covers the far corners faster than a car.
steps: After the story, open the map and look for dark, unvisited patches.
Drive, fly or sail through every named area — all 52 must be visited.
Use a plane or helicopter for remote corners; the trophy pops when the last area is uncovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map once discovered; hit one per gang — nine in total. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations done, so this is the first step of a much longer robbery list: keep a note of which gangs you have hit.
steps: Discover gang operations on the map as you explore.
Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang; keep going — the checklist needs all 39 operations.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites, so linger at the beachfront — sit, order a drink, and give the scene time to register — until it pops.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar or viewpoint overlooking the water.
Order a cocktail and stay at the spot with the view.
If it does not pop, try another beachfront bar — the exact trigger is still being confirmed.
trophies.note: Method unconfirmed: the guide sites list the trigger as still being pinned down. This guide will not invent a specific bar — the steps above are the honest approach the sources describe.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. The exact method is still being confirmed by the guide sites; a fast car and a straight run at the storefront is the reported approach. Build speed on a clear stretch before the showroom so you do not stall halfway through the glass.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass storefront.
Line up a straight, clear run at it in a fast car.
Drive straight through the glass and out the other side.
trophies.note: Method unconfirmed: the guide sites have not pinned down the exact showroom or approach. The steps above follow the reported method rather than inventing a specific location.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the reported method is to steal the three key valuables kept at the alley and escape. Visit the bowling alley, take the valuables and get out clean. While you are there, bowl a frame too: it ticks an activity type for Master of None.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Steal the three key valuables kept at the alley.
Escape clean; the trophy pops on the getaway.
trophies.note: Method reported, not fully confirmed: the guide sites describe the three-valuables theft as the trigger. If it does not pop, the alley's exact trigger is still being pinned down.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the reported method is to raise the Strength stat to its maximum for both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters (gym work and physical activity build Strength) until each hits the cap. It is a slow grind, so fold it into your free-roam routine rather than doing it in one sitting.
steps: Train Jason's Strength at the gym and through physical activity until it caps.
Do the same for Lucia — both characters must be at maximum.
The trophy pops when the second character's Strength hits the cap.
trophies.note: Method reported, not fully confirmed: the guide sites describe max Strength for both characters as the trigger.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — PlayStation tracks a count up to 500. Almost anything with consequences counts: crimes, choices in missions, robberies, stunts that draw attention. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough; check your profile progress in the Progress menu and keep playing the way the game rewards.
steps: Play normally — crimes, mission choices, robberies and attention-grabbing stunts all count.
Check your Criminal Profile count in the Progress menu from time to time.
The trophy pops at 500; it should land before the end of a full platinum run.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy, and its unlock method is still unconfirmed — the guide sites list it as unsolved. Its description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. Try failing an activity or challenge once and then passing it on the retry — a race, a shooting-range challenge or a drone race are good candidates.
steps: Pick an activity with a clear pass/fail — a race, a shooting-range challenge or a drone race.
Fail it once, then pass it on the immediate retry.
If it does not pop, keep the idea in mind for other retryable activities.
trophies.note: Method unconfirmed: no guide site has verified the trigger. This guide says so plainly instead of inventing one — it will be updated when a source confirms the method.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy, method still unconfirmed — the guide sites list it as unsolved, and its description ('What the hell just happened?') points at witnessing something strange or paranormal in Leonida. Explore odd spots at night and keep an eye out for unusual events — UFO lore, cryptid sightings and strange encounters are the usual suspects in this series.
steps: Explore unusual spots across Leonida, especially at night.
Watch for strange or paranormal events — the trophy is about witnessing something, not doing something.
Check the guide sites for new reports; this one is still being solved by the community.
trophies.note: Method unconfirmed: no guide site has verified the trigger. This guide says so plainly instead of inventing a location.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed; the reported approach is a drive-by swing at a pedestrian from a slow-moving car or bike. Go slow enough to aim, fast enough that it counts as a drive-by.
steps: Get in a car or on a bike and find a pedestrian on a quiet street.
Swing a melee weapon from the moving vehicle as you pass.
If it does not pop, vary the speed — the precise trigger is still being confirmed.
trophies.note: Method reported, not fully confirmed: the guide sites describe a melee drive-by but have not pinned down the exact conditions.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through your contacts a little at a time and the total builds up. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this overlaps fully with A Long Road — every robbery feeds both.
steps: Rob shops, trucks, vaults and gang operations to collect Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts a little at a time.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered in total — the same total the checklist wants.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything you buy counts. It adds up naturally over a 200-hour playthrough, especially once you start buying garage properties and kitting out cars. If you are close near the end, car mods are the fastest way to close the gap.
steps: Buy normally — clothes, weapons, food and car mods all count.
Garage properties and car customisation are the big-ticket items.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties across Leonida. Garages appear for sale as you explore and earn money — the robberies and fencing from the 100% checklist will fund them. Buy each one when its for-sale sign shows; the trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for garage properties with for-sale signs.
Fund them from robberies and laundered Marked Bills.
Buy all eight; the trophy pops on the last one.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone. Drive a vehicle you own into the app's registration flow and repeat for ten different vehicles. Any vehicles you already own count once registered — start with the cars already in your garages.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone.
Register a vehicle you own; repeat for ten different vehicles.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
